page_title: SAS 1-0 FIO | Sassuolo v Fiorentina 06/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+6' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) sees a yellow card from Rosario Abisso after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is adjudged offside.
89' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

88' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.
88' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' Alessio Dionisi has decided to make a change. Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
85' Substitution. Jeremy Toljan makes way for Filippo Missori (Sassuolo).
85' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
83' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' A substitution has been made. Domenico Berardi is replaced by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo).
80' A substitution has been made. Giacomo Bonaventura goes off and Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) comes on.
79' The linesman signals that M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
76' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Armand Lauriente is replaced by Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo).
74' Here comes a substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Josip Brekalo.
70' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
69' A yellow card for a tackle by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo). Rosario Abisso doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
69' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Fiorentina players look gutted.
68' Attention! Referee Rosario Abisso straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
67' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
66' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared.
64' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Andrea Consigli who easily stops the effort.
64' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
63' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Fiorentina.
63' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

61' What a poor attempt! Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
60' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
58' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
56' The game is interrupted as Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is flagged offside.
53' The main referee, Rosario Abisso, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is given a yellow card for dissent.
52' The manager makes a subsitution with Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) coming on for Arthur Melo.
52' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Rolando Mandragora will be replaced by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina).
52' The goal by Sassuolo won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
50' The Sassuolo players halt their celebrations as referee Rosario Abisso makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
48' The ball from the corner slips through the box to Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) and he produces a low drive into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
47' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45+256' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Sassuolo due to an offside in the build-up play.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
38' Referee Rosario Abisso sees the trip by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick.
37' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
35' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Rosario Abisso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' Rosario Abisso shows the yellow card to Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) for a heavy challenge.
34' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is able to continue to play.
33' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) trips an opposition player and Rosario Abisso signals a foul. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
31' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
30' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Fiorentina force their opponents to concede a corner.

28' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Rosario Abisso blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick to Fiorentina.

26' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Rosario Abisso with no other option than to blow for a foul. Free kick. Sassuolo will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' The resulting corner from Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
22' A dangerous looking corner kick from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared to safety by the defence.
19' The goal by Sassuolo is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
19' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Rosario Abisso is going to take a look using VAR.
19' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
18' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
16' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
16' Rosario Abisso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) and blew his whistle.
15' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
12' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
11' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is caught offside!

9' 1 - 0 Marcus Pedersen produces a sweet pass and picks out Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:0!
7' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).

6' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
5' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) makes a strong challenge and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul. Fiorentina are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) heads on.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Rosario Abisso.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
